title: A Extraction for the Asset
author: Odile Halloran
blurb: Tamsin Voss, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
